title: Controlled epsilon-area representation of legacy STTAB in Ribasim Basin semantics
purpose: Show structurally that the piecewise-linear SWAP STTAB storage curve can be represented to an explicitly controllable error by a Ribasim-compatible continuous level-area profile without retaining SWAP surface-water state.
disclosure: The epsilon-transition construction was analytically derived and explored before this preregistration. Q1H is therefore confirmatory rather than blind. The formal population uses a fresh seed and tests theorem-derived properties rather than an application acceptance threshold.

authorities.swap: F-PM08D1 exact-source 22-knot STTAB piecewise-linear storage semantics
authorities.ribasim_semantics: area-only Basin Profile is trapezoid-integrated to storage and linearly interpolated as level-to-area

construction: Convert the 22 SWAP STTAB knots to increasing SI level/storage and remove only the bottom constant roundoff offset.
Compute the constant storage slope on each SWAP interval.
At every internal STTAB knot replace the derivative jump by a symmetric linear area transition from left slope to right slope over [h-epsilon,h+epsilon].
Use the first/last interval slope at the domain endpoints.
Because the transition is symmetric, its integrated volume equals the exact step integral across the full transition; therefore cumulative error returns to zero at h+epsilon.
theorem_checks: All generated interval slopes and Ribasim area-profile values are nonnegative.
At every transition edge and all tested points outside transition zones, smoothed-profile storage equals SWAP piecewise-linear storage to 1e-11 m3.
Inside each symmetric transition the absolute storage error is bounded by epsilon*abs(slope_right-slope_left)/4 plus 1e-11 m3.
Top-of-domain cumulative storage returns to the SWAP value to 1e-11 m3.
Observed maximum error scales linearly with epsilon within floating-point tolerance.
interpretation: Q1H establishes controllability of representation error, not that any selected epsilon is acceptable for an application. Application-specific acceptance remains a separate authority decision.
nonclaims: No claim of exact direct STTAB mapping.
No claim that the legacy STTAB approximation is physically preferable to geometry-derived Ribasim storage.
No production admission or retirement authority.
